claim: Before a D18/PY-IT/eC9 useful-work claim is promoted beyond initial performance, B0/B1/B2 must be tested under separated intrinsic heat and intrinsic light stress with stabilized-Pmax tracking and paired mechanism observables, preserving fabrication hierarchy and all functional devices.
changed_evidentiary_state: Durability moves from an unspecified downstream requirement to a preregistered falsifier with source-grounded stress classes, fixed reporting horizon, machine-readable data contract, and explicit kill/narrow logic.

canonical_project_gate.source: technical/current-specification.md on main at run base
canonical_project_gate.classification: existing project gate; not introduced by this protocol

external_provenance.title: Suppressing electron-phonon coupling and energy loss in organic solar cells by modulating donor-acceptor penetrated-interface
facts_used: device measurements and thermal ageing were conducted inside a glovebox under inert atmosphere
the main article methods do not state a thermal-ageing temperature, duration, or durability result used here

external_provenance.title: Consensus statement for stability assessment and reporting for perovskite photovoltaics based on ISOS procedures
facts_used: ISOS-I notation separates intrinsic stress in inert atmosphere
ISOS-L-1I isolates light stress at room temperature
800-1000 W m^-2 illumination is recommended for light-soaking studies
if T80 is not reached, at least 1000 h ageing with eta_1000 reporting is recommended
sample and batch statistics and normalization values should be reported
MPPT is preferred when available and the hardware/algorithm should be documented
external_provenance.scope_note: Used as an ISOS-derived research-discipline precedent, not IEC certification and not a claim that perovskite-specific degradation physics transfers to OPV.

stress_arms.source_basis: ISOS-D-2I family; 65 C is an explicitly listed D-2 elevated temperature

stress_arms.temperature: room-temperature condition; record measured device temperature rather than inventing a tighter setpoint
stress_arms.electrical_state: maximum-power-point tracking when equipment supports it; otherwise stabilized operation near MPP with algorithm/procedure recorded
stress_arms.source_basis: ISOS-L-1I family plus consensus reporting guidance

horizon.eta_1000_definition: Pmax at 1000 h divided by the same device's accepted t=0 stabilized Pmax

paired_mechanism_observables.rule: A retained or lost Pmax advantage must not be assigned uniquely to EPC without these controls.

decision_rules: Initial useful-work eligibility still requires >=5% relative stabilized-Pmax improvement with the same sign across >=3 independent lots; this protocol does not relax that gate.
Durability evidence is not established by a champion device or by J-V scans alone; use stabilized Pmax on all functional devices not excluded by frozen QC.
If an arm's initial >=5% stabilized-Pmax advantage over B0 is absent at the frozen durability horizon, do not call that arm durable useful-work validation.

If voltage-loss/EPC observables remain favorable but stabilized Pmax advantage disappears, retain the result as mechanism science and investigate field generation, transport/contact, morphology, and degradation pathways.
If heat-only and light-only stresses diverge, preserve that divergence rather than averaging them into a single stability score.
No field lifetime or acceleration factor may be inferred from these accelerated tests without a validated acceleration model.
serious_conventional_explanations: ordinary morphology/domain coarsening or vertical-composition drift under heat
photo-oxidation or photochemical change if atmosphere/encapsulation control is imperfect
field-dependent generation or transport deterioration unrelated to EPC
batch/lot variability or correlated pixel repeats masquerading as durability differences
falsifier: A claimed durable interface/EPC useful-work advantage is falsified/narrowed if prospectively tracked stabilized Pmax no longer clears the existing useful-work gate at the durability horizon, especially when conventional degradation controls explain the loss.
synthetic_fixture_policy: Embedded synthetic rows exercise parser/arithmetic/decision logic only. They are not material constants, expected device behavior, or a physical durability threshold.
